items.source: Create the XmlReaderContext to pass over to the document reader.
items.translation: 创建 `XmlReaderContext` 传递给文档读取器。

items.source: Get the XmlReaderContext associated with this helper instance.
items.translation: 获取与此辅助实例关联的XmlReaderContext。

items.source: Create a new BeanDefinitionParserDelegate associated with the supplied XmlReaderContext.
items.translation: 创建一个与提供的XmlReaderContext关联的新 BeanDefinitionParserDelegate。

items.source: Uses of XmlReaderContext in org.springframework.beans.factory.xml
Uses of XmlReaderContext in org.springframework.context.annotation
items.translation: `org.springframework.context.annotation` 包中 `XmlReaderContext` 的用法

items.source: Contains an abstract XML-based BeanFactory implementation, including a standard "spring-beans" XSD.
items.translation: 包含一个抽象的基于 XML 的 `BeanFactory` 实现，包括标准的"spring-beans"XSD。

items.source:
Annotation support for the Application Context, including JSR-250 "common"
annotations, component-scanning, and Java-based metadata for creating
Spring-managed objects.
items.translation: 支持应用上下文的注解，包括 JSR-250“通用”注解、组件扫描以及用于创建 Spring 托管对象的基于 Java 的元数据。

items.source: Return the descriptor for the XML resource that this parser works on.
items.translation: 返回该解析器处理的 XML 资源的描述符。

items.source:
Read bean definitions from the given DOM document and
register them with the registry in the given reader context.
items.translation: 从给定的 DOM 文档中读取 Bean 定义，并在给定的 ReaderContext 中将它们注册到注册表中。

items.source:
This implementation parses bean definitions according to the "spring-beans" XSD
(or DTD, historically).
items.translation: 此实现根据"spring-beans"XSD（历史上为DTD）解析bean定义。
